```d
        l -= (lidOutline() - outer()).offset(0.5.mm).extrude(lidT - tabT).move(z: -0.01.mm) - outer().extrude(lidT);
        l += (lipOut - lipOut.offset(-lipT)).extrude(lipH).move(z: -lipH);
        if (closure == "snap")
            l += ridge(lipOut, bead).move(z: -lipH + beadZ);
    }
    if (closure == "screws")
        foreach (p; screwSpots())
            l -= cylinder(d: M3.clearance, h: 3 * lidT, center: true).move(x: p.x, y: p.y);
    if (closure == "flush")
    {
        // a hole in the middle for a finger to lift it by, its rims softened
        immutable hole = min(18.mm, innerD / 2);
        l = l.cut(circle(d: hole), on: faces.top, through: true)
            .chamfer(edges.filter(e => e.isCircle && e.radius == hole / 2), d: 0.6.mm);
    }
    return l;
}

/// The lid where it closes the box: on the rim, or in its step when flush.
Solid closedLid() => lidInPlace().move(z: closure == "flush" ? outerH - lidT : outerH);

/// On the box to see it closed, or beside it upside down (its top on the
/// bed) to print, turned about Y so that its tab stays at the front.
@part("#C9A27E")
Solid lid() => closed
    ? closedLid()
    : lidInPlace().rotate(y: 180.deg).move(x: outerW + 15.mm, z: lidT);

unittest
{
    writeln("base ", base.bbox.size, "  lid ", lid.bbox.size);
    // the lid closes without running into the box: only the snap's ridge
    // overlaps the wall, by the bead
    immutable overlap = (closedLid() & base).volume;
    assert(overlap < (closure == "snap" ? 200.mm ^^ 3 : 1.mm ^^ 3), "the lid does not fit the box");
}
```

## Example: knob on a shaft

```d
// Knob: fluted, for a potentiometer's D shaft
// A fluted knob for a potentiometer with a 6 mm D shaft, printable
// standing up as it is (no overhangs, no supports).
//
// Try it:
//  - change the values in Parameters, or pick a preset;
//  - edit the code: the view updates as you type;
//  - right-click a face or an edge to add a fillet, a hole, a pocket...
//    the GUI writes the code for you.
module knob;

import std.shapes;
import hardware : M3, hole;

// @param puts a field in the Parameters panel; @preset groups values under a name
@param("Diameter", min: 16.mm, max: 50.mm)
@preset("small", 18.mm) @preset("large", 36.mm)
immutable diameter = 26.mm;

@param("Height", min: 12.mm, max: 30.mm)
@preset("small", 16.mm) @preset("large", 20.mm)
immutable height = 17.mm;

@param("Flutes", min: 0, max: 30)
@preset("small", 10) @preset("large", 18)
immutable flutes = 14;

@param("Shaft clearance", min: 0.mm, max: 0.5.mm)
immutable clearance = 0.15.mm;

// the potentiometer shaft: 6 mm, with a flat leaving 4.5 mm
immutable shaftD = 6.mm;
immutable shaftFlat = 4.5.mm;
immutable shaftDepth = 10.mm;    // how far the shaft enters the knob

// the shape: a skirt at the bottom, a body narrowing towards the top
immutable r = diameter / 2;
immutable skirtR = r + 2.5.mm;
immutable skirtH = 1.6.mm;
immutable topR = r * 0.86;
immutable taper = atan((r - topR) / (height - skirtH));

/// A D-shaped prism: a cylinder with one side cut flat (towards +X).
Solid dShape(Length d, Length flat, Length h) =>
    cylinder(d: d, h: h) & box(d, d, h).move(x: flat - d);

/// The body as a profile (radius, height) turned around the axis.
Solid body()
{
    auto profile = polygon([
        vec(0.mm, 0.mm),
        vec(skirtR, 0.mm),
        vec(skirtR, skirtH),
        vec(r, skirtH + 2.5.mm),     // 45° up to the body: printable
        vec(topR, height),
        vec(0.mm, height),
    ]);
    return profile
        .revolve();
}

// @part marks a body to show and export; without a colour it is Sky Pop
@part
Solid knob()
{
    auto k = body()
        .fillet(edges.of(faces.top), r: 1.5.mm)
        .chamfer(edges.of(faces.bottom), d: 0.4.mm);

    // a shallow dish on top
    immutable dish = 4 * r;
    k -= sphere(r: dish).move(z: height + dish - 0.8.mm);

    // flutes: grooves leaning with the taper, half a step away from +X
    // so the pointer and the set screw fall between two of them
    immutable flute = 2 * PI * r / flutes * 0.55;
    foreach (i; 0 .. flutes)
        k -= cylinder(d: flute, h: height, center: true)
            .rotate(y: -taper)
            .move(x: (r + topR) / 2 + flute * 0.2, z: height / 2 + 5.mm)
            .rotate(z: (i + 0.5) * 360.deg / flutes);

    // the pointer: a groove across the top, in line with the flat of the shaft
    immutable pointer = topR * 0.6;
    k -= box(pointer, 1.2.mm, 3.mm)
        .move(x: topR - 2.5.mm - pointer / 2, z: height - 1.6.mm);

    // the shaft hole, ending in a cone so it prints without a bridge
    immutable hd = shaftD + 2 * clearance;
    k -= dShape(hd, shaftFlat + clearance, shaftDepth);
    k -= cone(d1: hd, d2: 0.mm, h: hd / 2).move(z: shaftDepth);

    // an M3 set screw pressing on the flat (hole() comes from the hardware library)
    k -= hole(M3, skirtR, "tap")
        .rotate(y: 90.deg)
        .move(x: skirtR, z: 6.mm);

    return k;
}

// a reference part: drawn see-through to check the fit, but left out of
// STL/3MF/STEP exports
@part("slategray", alpha: 0.35, export: false)
Solid shaft() => dShape(shaftD, shaftFlat, shaftDepth + 12.mm).move(z: -12.mm);

// unittests run after every evaluation: their output goes to the console
unittest
{
    assert(height >= shaftDepth + 5.mm, "the shaft would come out of the top: make the knob taller");
    writeln("knob: $(format("%.1f", knob.volume / 1.cm ^^ 3)) cm³");
}
```

## Example: a constrained sketch, a medal

```d
// A first sketch: a medal with an H and a rim in relief
module medal;

import std.shapes;

@param("Diameter", min: 30.mm, max: 60.mm)
immutable diameter = 40.mm;

@param("Rim width", min: 2.mm, max: 5.mm)
immutable rim = 3.5.mm;

// the disc under the relief, and how high the H and the
// rim stand on it
immutable base = 2.mm;
immutable relief = 1.mm;

/// The rim and the H, seen from above: a sketch.
Profile face()
{
    auto s = sketch();

    // drawn wrong on purpose, to see what each rule
    // below does: the inside of the rim a squashed
    // ellipse off the centre, the H small, crooked,
    // away from the middle; the centre is pinned at
    // the origin
    auto c = s.point(0, 0, fixed: true);
    s.circle(c, d: diameter);
    auto inner = s.ellipse(vec(2, 2));

    // the H: twelve points, drawn by eye, and the
    // lines round them
    auto h = s.polyline([
        vec(-3, -4), vec(0, -5), vec(1, 1),
        vec(4, 2), vec(3, -5), vec(6, -4),
        vec(6, 7), vec(4, 8), vec(4, 4),
        vec(1, 3), vec(0, 8), vec(-3, 7),
    ], closed: true);

    // the rim: the ellipse round the same centre, as
    // wide as tall (a circle), its size
    s.concentric(inner, c);
    s.equal(inner);
    s.radius(inner, rx: diameter / 2 - rim);

    // across and up, in turn
    foreach (i, l; h)
    {
        if (i % 2 == 0)
            s.horizontal(l);
        else
            s.vertical(l);
    }

    // the strokes all 5 mm wide, the letter 22 mm tall
    s.length(h[0], 5.mm);
    s.equal(h[4], h[0]);
    s.equal(h[6], h[0]);
    s.equal(h[10], h[0]);
    s.length(h[11], 22.mm);
    s.equal(h[5], h[11]);
    s.distance(h[2].start, h[8].end, 5.mm, along: Y);

    // 18 mm wide, the feet level, the bar in the middle
    s.distance(h[0].start, h[5].start, 18.mm, along: X);
    s.horizontal(h[0].start, h[5].start);
    s.equal(h[1], h[9]);

    // the H in the middle: the centre halfway along a
    // diagonal that is not part of the outline
    auto diagonal = s.line(h[0].start, h[6].start,
        construction: true);
    s.midpoint(c, diagonal);

    writeln("degrees of freedom left: ", s.dof);
    return s.profile;
}

@part
Solid medal()
{
    // the disc, the relief on it, a keyring hole
    // through the rim at the top
    return circle(d: diameter).extrude(base)
        + face().extrude(relief).move(z: base)
        - cylinder(d: rim - 1.mm, h: 10.mm)
            .move(y: diameter / 2 - rim / 2, z: -1.mm);
}
```

## Example: the shapes of a sketch

```d
// The shapes a sketch has, each fully constrained
module shapes;

import std.shapes;

@part
Solid sampler()
{
    auto s = sketch();

    // places on a grid, 35 mm apart, and points pinned
    // there
    Vec2 grid(double x, double y) =>
        vec(x * 35, y * 35);
    SketchPoint at(Vec2 p) =>
        s.point(p.x, p.y, fixed: true);

    // a rectangle from its centre, the corners round
    s.rect(center: at(grid(-1, 1)), w: 26.mm, h: 18.mm,
        corner: 4.mm);

    // hexagons: the circle through the corners, or
    // the one the sides touch (across the flats)
    auto hex = s.polygon(at(grid(0, 1)), 6, d: 24.mm);
    s.horizontal(hex[0]);
    auto nut = s.polygon(at(grid(1, 1)), 6, d: 20.mm,
        fit: "sides");
    s.horizontal(nut[0]);

    // an ellipse, tilted
    s.ellipse(at(grid(-1, 0)), rx: 13.mm, ry: 7.mm,
        angle: 20.deg);

    // a slot between two points, 8 mm wide
    s.slot(at(grid(0, 0) - vec(10, 0)),
        at(grid(0, 0) + vec(10, 0)), w: 8.mm);

    // a pentagon in a circle (construction: not part of
    // the outline), its corners on it
    auto ring = s.circle(at(grid(1, 0)), d: 24.mm,
        construction: true);
    auto five = s.polygon(ring.center, 5);
    s.on(five, ring);
    s.vertical(five[0].start, ring.center);

    // a square round a circle: every side touching it
    auto round = s.circle(at(grid(-1, -1)), d: 20.mm,
        construction: true);
    s.tangent(s.rect(center: round.center), round);

    // a rectangle in a circle, one side given
    auto disc = s.circle(at(grid(0, -1)), d: 26.mm,
        construction: true);
    auto inside = s.rect(center: disc.center);
    s.on(inside, disc);
    s.length(inside[0], 22.mm);

    // a circle and an ellipse made round: as wide as
    // tall
    s.circle(at(grid(1, -1) - vec(6, 0)), d: 10.mm);
    auto e = s.ellipse(at(grid(1, -1) + vec(7, 0)));
    s.equal(e);
    s.radius(e, rx: 5.mm);

    writeln("degrees of freedom left: ", s.dof);
    return s.profile.extrude(2.mm);
}
```

## Example: a pillow block, five sketches on five surfaces

```d
// Pillow block: a 608 bearing housing from five sketches
// A pillow block: a housing for a 608 ball bearing,
// bolted down by two slotted feet. Each feature is a
// sketch drawn on a different surface: the ground,
// the front of the foot, the top of the foot, the
// front of the upright and its slanted flank.
module pillowblock;

import std.shapes;
import hardware : M5;

@param("Foot length", min: 80.mm, max: 140.mm)
immutable footLength = 90.mm;

@param("Foot width", min: 30.mm, max: 50.mm)
immutable footWidth = 30.mm;

@param("Foot height", min: 5.mm, max: 15.mm)
immutable footHeight = 8.mm;

@param("Shaft height above the foot", min: 20.mm, max: 50.mm)
immutable axisHeight = 26.mm;

@param("Upright width at the bottom", min: 40.mm, max: 70.mm)
immutable uprightWidth = 50.mm;

@param("Upright thickness", min: 10.mm, max: 20.mm)
immutable uprightDepth = 16.mm;

@param("Slot travel", min: 2.mm, max: 10.mm)
immutable travel = 6.mm;

// the 608 bearing: 22 mm across, 7 mm wide
immutable bearingD = 22.mm;
immutable bearingWidth = 7.mm;

immutable footCorner = 6.mm;
immutable spotFace = 9.mm;
immutable topRadius = 17.mm;

// the slots halfway between the upright and the ends
immutable slotX = (uprightWidth + footLength) / 4;

unittest
{
    assert(footLength / 2 - slotX
        >= travel / 2 + spotFace / 2 + 2.mm,
        "no room for the slots: a longer foot, a "
        ~ "narrower upright or less travel");
}

/// The foot seen from above, on the ground (XY).
Profile footSketch()
{
    auto s = sketch();
    auto c = s.point(0, 0, fixed: true);
    s.rect(center: c, w: footLength, h: footWidth,
        corner: footCorner);
    return s.profile;
}

/// The two bolt slots, w wide: through the foot, and
/// wider for the washers on its top face.
Profile slotsSketch(Length w)
{
    auto s = sketch();
    auto c = s.point(0, 0, fixed: true);
    foreach (side; [-1, 1])
    {
        auto a = s.point(side * (slotX - travel / 2), 0);
        auto b = s.point(side * (slotX + travel / 2), 0);
        s.slot(a, b, w: w);

        // on the long axis, slotX from the middle
        s.horizontal(c, a);
        s.horizontal(a, b);
        s.distance(c, a, slotX - travel / 2, along: X);
        s.distance(a, b, travel);
    }
    return s.profile;
}

/// The upright seen from the front, standing on the
/// foot: two flanks touching the round top, and the
/// hole for the shaft.
Profile uprightSketch()
{
    auto s = sketch();
    auto o = s.point(0, 0, fixed: true);
    auto bl = s.point(-uprightWidth / 2, 0);
    auto br = s.point(uprightWidth / 2, 0);
    auto centre = s.point(0, axisHeight);
    auto tr = s.point(topRadius, axisHeight + 4.mm);
    auto tl = s.point(-topRadius, axisHeight + 4.mm);

    auto bottom = s.line(bl, br);
    auto right = s.line(br, tr);
    auto top = s.arc(centre, tr, tl);
    auto left = s.line(tl, bl);

    s.horizontal(bottom);
    s.midpoint(o, bottom);
    s.length(bottom, uprightWidth);
    s.vertical(o, centre);
    s.distance(o, centre, axisHeight);
    s.radius(top, topRadius);
    s.tangent(right, top);
    s.tangent(left, top);

    // room for the shaft behind the bearing
    s.circle(centre, d: bearingD - 8.mm);
    return s.profile;
}

/// The bearing's seat, on the upright's front face:
/// the bearing, and a notch across it to lever it out.
Profile seatSketch()
{
    auto s = sketch();
    auto c = s.point(0, 0, fixed: true);
    s.circle(c, d: bearingD);
    s.slot(bearingD + 6.mm, 3.mm, center: c);
    return s.profile;
}

/// A label sunk into the slanted flank, its letters
/// left standing.
Profile labelSketch()
{
    auto s = sketch();
    auto c = s.point(0, 0, fixed: true);
    s.rect(center: c, w: 9.mm, h: 24.mm, corner: 2.mm);
    return s.profile
        - text("608", size: 5.mm).centered.rotate(90);
}

@part("White Pop")
Solid pillowBlock()
{
    // 1. on the ground: the foot, its top edge rounded
    // before anything is cut in it
    auto foot = footSketch().extrude(footHeight);
    auto block = foot
        .fillet(edges.of(faces.top), r: 1.5.mm);

    // 2. on the front of the foot, moved back to the
    // middle: the upright, pushed in from there
    auto inset = (footWidth - uprightDepth) / 2;
    auto front = block.plane(faces.front)
        .offset(-inset)
        .frame(origin: vec(0, 0, footHeight));
    auto upright = uprightSketch()
        .extrude(-uprightDepth)
        .placeOn(front);
    block += upright;

    // where the upright meets the foot, rounded
    block = block.fillet(
        edges.between(faces.from(upright),
            faces.from(foot)),
        r: 3.mm);

    // 3. on the top of the foot: the slots through it,
    // and flat seats for the washers
    auto top = foot.frame(faces.top);
    block = block.cut(slotsSketch(M5.clearance),
        on: top, through: true);
    block = block.cut(slotsSketch(spotFace),
        on: top, depth: 1.5.mm);

    // 4. on the upright's front face, round the shaft:
    // the bearing's seat
    auto face = faces.from(upright)
        .filter(f => f.normal.y < -0.99);
    block = block.cut(seatSketch(),
        on: block.frame(face,
            origin: vec(0, 0, footHeight + axisHeight)),
        depth: bearingWidth + 0.2.mm);

    // 5. on the right flank, leaning: the label
    auto flank = faces.from(upright)
        .farthest(X);
    return block.cut(labelSketch(),
        on: block.frame(flank), depth: 0.6.mm);
}
```

## Library source: hardware

```d
module hardware;

import threads : threadedRod;

/// Metric screw sizes (ISO 4762 socket head cap screws, ISO 4032 nuts,
/// ISO 7089 washers) with the holes to print or drill for them.
struct Screw
{
    string name;
    Length d;           /// nominal diameter
    Length pitch;       /// coarse thread pitch
    Length tap;         /// pilot hole for tapping or self-tapping
    Length clearance;   /// clearance hole
    Length head;        /// head diameter
    Length headHeight;
    Length key;         /// hex key size (across flats)
    Length nut;         /// nut width across flats
    Length nutHeight;
    Length washer;      /// washer outer diameter
    Length insert;      /// hole for a heat-set threaded insert
    Length insertDepth;
}

immutable M2 = Screw("M2", 2.mm, 0.4.mm, 1.6.mm, 2.4.mm, 3.8.mm, 2.mm, 1.5.mm, 4.mm, 1.6.mm, 5.mm, 3.2.mm, 4.mm);
immutable M2_5 = Screw("M2.5", 2.5.mm, 0.45.mm, 2.05.mm, 2.9.mm, 4.5.mm, 2.5.mm, 2.mm, 5.mm, 2.mm, 6.mm, 3.6.mm, 5.mm);
immutable M3 = Screw("M3", 3.mm, 0.5.mm, 2.5.mm, 3.4.mm, 5.5.mm, 3.mm, 2.5.mm, 5.5.mm, 2.4.mm, 7.mm, 4.2.mm, 5.7.mm);
immutable M4 = Screw("M4", 4.mm, 0.7.mm, 3.3.mm, 4.5.mm, 7.mm, 4.mm, 3.mm, 7.mm, 3.2.mm, 9.mm, 5.6.mm, 8.1.mm);
immutable M5 = Screw("M5", 5.mm, 0.8.mm, 4.2.mm, 5.5.mm, 8.5.mm, 5.mm, 4.mm, 8.mm, 4.7.mm, 10.mm, 6.4.mm, 9.5.mm);
immutable M6 = Screw("M6", 6.mm, 1.mm, 5.mm, 6.6.mm, 10.mm, 6.mm, 5.mm, 10.mm, 5.2.mm, 12.mm, 8.mm, 12.7.mm);
immutable M8 = Screw("M8", 8.mm, 1.25.mm, 6.8.mm, 9.mm, 13.mm, 8.mm, 6.mm, 13.mm, 6.8.mm, 16.mm, 9.7.mm, 12.7.mm);

/// Hexagonal prism standing on XY, flats parallel to the X axis.
Solid hexPrism(Length acrossFlats, Length h)
{
    auto slab = box(acrossFlats * 2, acrossFlats, h);
    return slab & slab.rotate(z: 60) & slab.rotate(z: 120);
}

/// Socket head cap screw. The underside of the head lies on z = 0: the head
/// grows upwards and the shank downwards, so the screw drops into a hole.
/// threaded: true models the ISO thread (slower); otherwise the shank is plain.
Solid screw(Screw s, Length length, bool socket = true, bool threaded = false)
{
    auto shank = threaded
        ? threadedRod(s.d, s.pitch, length).move(z: -length)
        : cylinder(d: s.d, h: length)
            .chamfer(edges.filter(e => e.isCircle && e.mid.z < 1.mm), d: s.d * 0.1)
            .move(z: -length);
    auto head = cylinder(d: s.head, h: s.headHeight)
        .fillet(edges.filter(e => e.isCircle && e.mid.z > s.headHeight / 2), r: s.d * 0.12);
    if (socket)
        head -= hexPrism(s.key, s.headHeight).move(z: s.headHeight * 0.45);
    return head + shank;
}

/// Hex nut standing on z = 0, with the corners chamfered on both faces.
/// threaded: true cuts the ISO thread in the hole.
Solid nut(Screw s, bool threaded = false)
{
    // a cone narrow at the face and wider than the corners at mid height
    auto lower = cone(d1: s.nut * 0.95, d2: s.nut * 1.4, h: s.nutHeight / 2);
    auto upper = lower.mirror(Z).move(z: s.nutHeight);
    auto body = hexPrism(s.nut, s.nutHeight) & (lower + upper);
    if (threaded)
        return body - threadedRod(s.d, s.pitch, s.nutHeight + 2 * s.pitch, chamfer: false).move(z: -s.pitch);
    return body - cylinder(d: s.d, h: 3 * s.nutHeight, center: true);
}

/// Flat washer standing on z = 0.
Solid washer(Screw s) => cylinder(d: s.washer, h: s.d * 0.2) - cylinder(d: s.clearance, h: s.d, center: true);

/// A hole to subtract, with its top on z = 0 going down `depth`:
/// "clearance" (the screw passes), "tap" (pilot hole for the thread),
/// "insert" (heat-set insert), "counterbore" (clearance with room for the
/// head) or "countersink" (for flat heads).
Solid hole(Screw s, Length depth, string kind = "clearance")
{
    switch (kind)
    {
    case "clearance":
        return cylinder(d: s.clearance, h: depth + 0.01.mm).move(z: -depth);
    case "tap":
        return cylinder(d: s.tap, h: depth + 0.01.mm).move(z: -depth);
    case "insert":
        return cylinder(d: s.insert, h: s.insertDepth).move(z: -s.insertDepth)
            + cylinder(d: s.tap, h: depth).move(z: -depth);
    case "counterbore":
        return cylinder(d: s.head + 0.6.mm, h: s.headHeight + 0.2.mm).move(z: -s.headHeight - 0.2.mm)
            + cylinder(d: s.clearance, h: depth).move(z: -depth);
    case "countersink":
        return cone(d1: s.clearance, d2: s.d * 2, h: s.d / 2).move(z: -s.d / 2)
            + cylinder(d: s.clearance, h: depth).move(z: -depth);
    default:
        assert(false, "hole kind must be clearance, tap, insert, counterbore or countersink, not " ~ kind);
    }
}

/// A pocket to trap a nut, from z = 0 going down `depth` (with a little clearance).
Solid nutTrap(Screw s, Length depth, Length clearance = 0.2.mm) =>
    hexPrism(s.nut + 2 * clearance, depth + 0.01.mm).move(z: -depth);
```

## Library source: threads

```d
module threads;

/// ISO metric threads (basic profile, 60°). Threads are real geometry: they
/// print and export to STEP, but take longer to compute than plain shapes.

/// Height of the thread tooth for a pitch (from the minor to the major diameter).
Length toothHeight(Length pitch) => 0.5413 * pitch;

/// A threaded rod of nominal diameter `d` standing on z = 0, with the ends
/// chamfered (chamfer: false leaves them square).
Solid threadedRod(Length d, Length pitch, Length length, bool chamfer = true, bool left = false)
{
    // built from its boundary (each corner of the profile on its own helix, ruled faces between
    // them), cut to length: see isoThread
    auto rod = isoThread(d: d, pitch: pitch, length: length, chamfer: chamfer ? toothHeight(pitch) : 0.mm);
    // left-handed: the right-handed one mirrored
    return left ? rod.mirror(XZ) : rod;
}

/// A tool to subtract for an internal thread that a `d` screw fits, from
/// z = 0 going down `depth`. `clearance` widens it for printed parts.
Solid tappedHole(Length d, Length pitch, Length depth, Length clearance = 0.15.mm) =>
    threadedRod(d + 2 * clearance, pitch, depth + pitch, chamfer: false).move(z: -depth);
```

## Library source: gears

```d
module gears;

/// Involute spur gears and racks. `m` is the module (pitch diameter / teeth):
/// two gears mesh when they have the same module and pressure angle, with
/// their centres `centerDistance(m, z1, z2)` apart.

Length pitchDiameter(Length m, int teeth) => m * teeth;
Length outsideDiameter(Length m, int teeth) => m * (teeth + 2);
Length rootDiameter(Length m, int teeth) => m * (teeth - 2.5);
Length centerDistance(Length m, int teeth1, int teeth2) => m * (teeth1 + teeth2) / 2;

/// Angle of the involute of a circle of radius rb at radius r.
double involute(Length rb, Length r)
{
    immutable t = sqrt((r / rb) ^^ 2 - 1);
    return t - atan(t) / 1.rad;
}

/// The outline of a spur gear centred on the origin, a tooth on +X.
/// backlash thins the teeth (measured on the pitch circle) so that printed
/// gears do not bind.
Profile gearProfile(Length m, int teeth, Angle pressure = 20.deg, Length backlash = 0.1.mm, int steps = 6)
{
    assert(teeth >= 6, "a gear needs at least 6 teeth");
    immutable r = m * teeth / 2;
    immutable rb = r * cos(pressure);
    immutable ra = r + m;
    immutable rf = r - 1.25 * m;
    // half the tooth thickness on the pitch circle, as an angle, plus the involute offset
    assert(backlash >= 0.mm, "the backlash cannot be negative");
    assert(backlash < PI * m / 2, "the backlash would thin the teeth to nothing: keep it below half the tooth (π·m/2)");
    immutable half = PI / (2 * teeth) - backlash / (2 * r) + involute(rb, r);
    immutable start = max(rb, rf);
    Vec2[] pts;
    foreach (k; 0 .. teeth)
    {
        immutable c = 2 * PI * k / teeth;
        Vec2[] flank;    // from the root to the tip, on the side of negative angles
        if (rf < rb)
            flank ~= vec(rf * cos(c - half), rf * sin(c - half));
        foreach (i; 0 .. steps + 1)
        {
            immutable rr = start + (ra - start) * i / steps;
            immutable a = c - half + involute(rb, rr);
            flank ~= vec(rr * cos(a), rr * sin(a));
        }
        pts ~= flank;
        // the other flank, mirrored around the tooth's centre line, from the tip to the root
        foreach_reverse (p; flank)
        {
            immutable a = 2 * c - atan2(p.y, p.x) / 1.rad;
            immutable rr = sqrt(p.x ^^ 2 + p.y ^^ 2);
            pts ~= vec(rr * cos(a), rr * sin(a));
        }
    }
    return polygon(pts);
}

/// A spur gear standing on z = 0, with an optional bore.
Solid spurGear(Length m, int teeth, Length thickness, Length bore = 0.mm, Angle pressure = 20.deg,
    Length backlash = 0.1.mm)
{
    auto g = gearProfile(m, teeth, pressure, backlash).extrude(thickness);
    if (bore > 0.mm)
        g -= cylinder(d: bore, h: 3 * thickness, center: true);
    return g;
}

/// A straight rack along +X starting at x = 0, teeth up, pitch line at y = 0.
Solid rack(Length m, int teeth, Length thickness, Length base = 0.mm, Angle pressure = 20.deg)
{
    assert(teeth >= 1, "a rack needs at least 1 tooth");
    immutable p = PI * m;
    immutable b = base > 0.mm ? base : 2 * m;
    immutable t = tan(pressure);
    Vec2[] pts = [vec(0.mm, -1.25 * m - b)];
    foreach (k; 0 .. teeth)
    {
        immutable x0 = k * p;
        pts ~= [vec(x0, -1.25 * m), vec(x0 + p / 4 - 1.25 * m * t, -1.25 * m), vec(x0 + p / 4 + m * t, m),
                vec(x0 + 3 * p / 4 - m * t, m), vec(x0 + 3 * p / 4 + 1.25 * m * t, -1.25 * m)];
    }
    pts ~= [vec(teeth * p, -1.25 * m), vec(teeth * p, -1.25 * m - b)];
    return polygon(pts).extrude(thickness);
}
```

## Library source: hinges

```d
module hinges;

/// The two leaves of a hinge, printed in place: they come out of the
/// printer already joined and turn around the X axis.
struct Hinge
{
    Solid fixed;    /// the leaf on -Y, with the pin
    Solid moving;   /// the leaf on +Y, turning around the pin
}

/// A print-in-place hinge along X, centred on the origin, leaves lying flat
/// on z = 0 and the axis at z = thickness. `knuckles` alternate between
/// the leaves (odd numbers keep it symmetric).
Hinge hinge(Length length = 40.mm, Length width = 15.mm, Length thickness = 3.mm, int knuckles = 5,
    Length clearance = 0.4.mm)
{
    assert(knuckles >= 3, "a hinge needs at least 3 knuckles");
    immutable outer = 2 * thickness;           // knuckle diameter
    immutable pin = outer * 0.45;
    immutable segment = length / knuckles;

    /// Knuckle i with the web that joins it to its leaf (side -1 or +1).
    Solid knuckle(int i, int side)
    {
        immutable x0 = -length / 2 + i * segment + (i > 0 ? clearance / 2 : 0.mm);
        immutable x1 = -length / 2 + (i + 1) * segment - (i < knuckles - 1 ? clearance / 2 : 0.mm);
        immutable reach = outer / 2 + clearance;
        auto web = box(x1 - x0, reach, thickness).move(x: (x0 + x1) / 2, y: side * reach / 2);
        return cylinder(d: outer, h: x1 - x0).rotate(y: 90).move(x: x0, z: thickness) + web;
    }

    Solid a = box(length, width, thickness).move(y: -width / 2 - outer / 2 - clearance);
    Solid b = box(length, width, thickness).move(y: width / 2 + outer / 2 + clearance);
    foreach (i; 0 .. knuckles)
    {
        if (i % 2 == 0)
            a += knuckle(i, -1);
        else
            b += knuckle(i, 1);
    }
    // the pin belongs to the fixed leaf and runs through the moving knuckles with clearance
    a += cylinder(d: pin, h: length - 2 * clearance).rotate(y: 90).move(x: -length / 2 + clearance, z: thickness);
    foreach (i; 0 .. knuckles)
        if (i % 2 == 1)
            b -= cylinder(d: pin + 2 * clearance, h: length).rotate(y: 90).move(x: -length / 2, z: thickness);
    return Hinge(a, b);
}
```

## Library source: snaps

```d
module snaps;

/// Cantilever snap-fit hooks. The hook stands on z = 0 and leans out along
/// +X; print it standing so the layers run along the beam.

/// A hook: a flexible beam `length` long with a barb `overhang` deep at the
/// top. `lead` is the slope that pushes it aside when inserting.
Solid snapHook(Length length = 10.mm, Length thickness = 1.5.mm, Length width = 5.mm, Length overhang = 1.mm,
    Angle lead = 30.deg)
{
    immutable barb = overhang / tan(lead);     // height of the sloped face
    auto profile = polygon([vec(0.mm, 0.mm), vec(thickness, 0.mm), vec(thickness, length),
                            vec(thickness + overhang, length), vec(thickness, length + barb),
                            vec(0.mm, length + barb)]);
    // drawn in the XY plane (y up the beam), then stood up
    return profile.extrude(width).move(z: -width / 2).rotate(x: 90).move(y: 0.mm);
}

/// The slot a hook clicks into, to subtract from the mating wall: a window
/// `clearance` larger than the barb.
Solid snapSlot(Length thickness = 1.5.mm, Length width = 5.mm, Length overhang = 1.mm, Length wall = 2.mm,
    Length clearance = 0.3.mm) =>
    box(thickness + overhang + 2 * clearance, width + 2 * clearance, wall + 1.mm)
        .move(x: (thickness + overhang) / 2, z: -0.5.mm);
```

## Library source: enclosures

```d
module enclosures;

import hardware : Screw, M3, hole;

/// Boxes with rounded corners and enclosures with lids.

/// A box centred in X and Y on z = 0, with vertical edges rounded by `r`.
Solid roundedBox(Length x, Length y, Length z, Length r = 3.mm) =>
    box(x, y, z).fillet(edges.parallel(Z), r: r);

/// An open box: walls `wall` thick, open on top.
Solid tray(Length x, Length y, Length z, Length wall = 2.mm, Length r = 3.mm) =>
    roundedBox(x, y, z, r).shell(open: faces.top, thickness: wall);

/// A base and a lid that fit together, both standing on z = 0.
struct Enclosure
{
    Solid base;
    Solid lid;
}

/// An enclosure with `inner` free space (x, y, z), a lid with a lip that
/// fits inside the base, and a screw post in each corner.
Enclosure enclosure(Vec3 inner, Length wall = 2.mm, Length r = 3.mm, Length lidHeight = 4.mm,
    Screw screw = M3, Length clearance = 0.2.mm)
{
    immutable ox = inner.x + 2 * wall, oy = inner.y + 2 * wall;
    auto base = tray(ox, oy, inner.z + wall, wall, r);
    auto lid = roundedBox(ox, oy, wall, r);
    // the lip: a thin ring that slides into the base
    immutable lx = inner.x - 2 * clearance, ly = inner.y - 2 * clearance;
    auto lip = roundedBox(lx, ly, lidHeight, max(r - wall, 0.5.mm)) - roundedBox(lx - 2 * wall, ly - 2 * wall, lidHeight * 3,
        max(r - 2 * wall, 0.5.mm)).move(z: -lidHeight);
    lid += lip.move(z: wall);

    // posts: tapped for the screw in the base, clearance holes in the lid.
    // The screw's axis is as near the corner as it can be: its hole keeps
    // 1.2 mm of wall outside it, across the rounded corner too, and its head
    // stays on the lid. With thick walls the axis is inside the wall and the
    // post all but disappears into the corner
    immutable postR = screw.tap / 2 + screw.d * 0.8;
    immutable keep = max(screw.tap / 2 + 1.2.mm, screw.head / 2 + 0.5.mm);   // from the axis to the outside
    // the axis' distance from the inner faces (negative: inside the walls)
    auto inset = keep - wall;
    if (keep > r)
        inset = max(inset, r - wall);
    else
        inset = max(inset, r - wall - (r - keep) / sqrt(2.0));
    immutable px = inner.x / 2 - inset, py = inner.y / 2 - inset;
    immutable postH = inner.z + wall - lidHeight - clearance;
    // from the axis to the middle of the walls: the post is one piece with
    // the corner it stands in, with no gap behind it
    immutable reach = inset + wall / 2;
    foreach (sx; [-1, 1])
        foreach (sy; [-1, 1])
        {
            auto post = cylinder(r: postR, h: postH);
            if (reach > 0.1.mm)
                post += box(reach, reach, postH).move(x: sx * reach / 2, y: sy * reach / 2);
            // near the corner the post would stick out: trimmed by the box's outside
            base += post.move(x: sx * px, y: sy * py) & roundedBox(ox, oy, postH, r);
            // from the rim (the screw may go through the wall) down to the floor
            base -= hole(screw, inner.z, "tap").move(x: sx * px, y: sy * py, z: inner.z + wall);
            lid -= cylinder(d: screw.clearance, h: 10 * wall, center: true).move(x: sx * px, y: sy * py);
            // room for the post in the lip, the clearance all round it; the
            // square reaches past the lip, which stops short of the corner
            immutable out = max(inset, 0.mm) + wall + clearance;
            auto room = cylinder(r: postR + clearance, h: lidHeight * 2)
                + box(out, out, lidHeight * 2).move(x: sx * out / 2, y: sy * out / 2);
            lid -= room.move(x: sx * px, y: sy * py, z: wall);
        }
    return Enclosure(base, lid);
}
```

## Library source: carlo

```d
module carlo;

/// Carlo, hackerscad's mascot: a bag clip whose toothed
/// slot and keyring eye make a little crocodile. Fold
/// the top of a bag of biscuits and push it into the
/// wavy slot: the teeth hold it. The start example
/// (examples/00_carlo.hcad) shows this same code;
/// chapter 13 of the tutorial explains it.

/// Carlo lying flat on z = 0, `height` tall, the
/// slot opening towards +X. `lean` is how far the back
/// and the tips lean (the clip slides onto the bag).
/// `mouth` tilts the lower jaw: down to open the slot
/// towards the tips (it slides on more easily), up to
/// close it (it holds tighter). `eye` adds the keyring
/// eye on the top corner. Prints flat, as it comes: a
/// constrained sketch, extruded.
Solid carlo(int teeth = 3, Length height = 15.mm,
    Length toothR = 2.5.mm, Length gap = 2.9.mm,
    Length jaw = 5.mm, Length back = 5.4.mm,
    Angle lean = 17.deg, Angle mouth = 1.5.deg,
    bool eye = true)
{
    assert(teeth >= 1, "a jaw needs a tooth at least");
    auto s = sketch();

    // where the points start: near where they end up
    // (the constraints below move them into place),
    // from the rows of teeth, the top and bottom sides
    // and the slot's depth
    immutable axis = toothR + gap / 2;
    immutable top = axis + toothR + jaw;
    immutable slot = 4 * teeth * toothR;
    immutable slope = tan(lean);
    auto a = s.point(-back + top * slope, -top,
        fixed: true);
    auto b = s.point(slot + 2 * toothR, -top);
    auto c = s.point(slot - 2 * toothR, top);

    // the block: a level top, the back leaning, the
    // tips of the jaws parallel to it
    auto bottom = s.line(a, b);
    SketchLine left, topSide;
    immutable corner = -back - top * slope; // top left
    if (eye)
    {
        // the eye: a ring on the top edge, its centre
        // on the top's line, round over the corner and
        // down onto the back, touching it; where it
        // rises from the top, a small rounding (an arc
        // touching both), not a corner
        immutable eyeR = 5.mm, nook = 1.5.mm;
        immutable rise = corner + 2 * eyeR;
        auto centre = s.point(corner + eyeR, top);
        auto eyeBack = s.point(corner + 3.mm * slope,
            top - 3.mm);
        auto nookCentre = s.point(rise + 1.mm,
            top + nook);
        auto nookTop = s.point(rise + 1.mm, top);
        auto nookEye = s.point(rise - 0.3.mm,
            top + 1.mm);
        left = s.line(a, eyeBack);
        topSide = s.line(c, nookTop);
        auto ring = s.arc(centre, nookEye, eyeBack);
        auto rounding = s.arc(nookCentre, nookEye,
            nookTop);
        s.on(centre, topSide);
        s.radius(ring, eyeR);
        s.tangent(left, ring);
        s.radius(rounding, nook);
        s.tangent(topSide, rounding);
        s.tangent(ring, rounding);
        s.distance(a, centre, 2 * top, along: Y);

        // the keyring hole, in the middle of the eye
        s.circle(centre, d: 3.8.mm);
    }
    else
    {
        // no eye: the back meets the top in a corner,
        // rounded
        auto d = s.point(corner, top);
        left = s.line(a, d);
        topSide = s.line(c, d);
        s.distance(a, d, 2 * top, along: Y);
        s.fillet(d, 2.5.mm);
    }
    s.horizontal(topSide);
    s.angle(topSide, left, 90.deg - lean);

    // the two rows of teeth: semicircles of one radius,
    // end to end, pocket and tooth in turn; a row is
    // points along a line, each arc between two of
    // them, its centre on the line too. The upper row
    // is level, the lower one tilts by the mouth. The
    // first pocket of each row starts where it touches
    // the end of the slot instead, and the last tooth
    // ends where it touches the tip of its jaw
    SketchPoint[] lower, upper;
    foreach (i; 0 .. 2 * teeth + 1)
    {
        lower ~= s.point(2 * toothR * i, -axis);
        upper ~= s.point(2 * toothR * i, axis);
    }
    SketchArc firstLower, firstUpper;
    SketchArc lastLower, lastUpper;

    // the upper row's last centre: with upper[1], its
    // direction
    SketchPoint lastCentre;

    // the lower row's points and centres, put on its
    // line below
    SketchPoint[] lowerOnRow;
    foreach (k; 0 .. 2 * teeth)
    {
        immutable x = 2 * toothR * k + toothR;
        auto cl = s.point(x, -axis);
        auto cu = s.point(x, axis);

        // counter-clockwise from start to end: left to
        // right goes under, right to left goes over.
        // Lower row: pockets down, teeth up; upper row:
        // pockets up, teeth down (facing the lower
        // pockets)
        auto pl = k % 2 == 0
            ? s.arc(cl, lower[k], lower[k + 1])
            : s.arc(cl, lower[k + 1], lower[k]);
        auto pu = k % 2 == 0
            ? s.arc(cu, upper[k + 1], upper[k])
            : s.arc(cu, upper[k], upper[k + 1]);
        s.radius(pl, toothR);
        s.radius(pu, toothR);

        // each centre on its row; the upper row level
        immutable onRow = k == 0 ? k + 1 : k;
        lowerOnRow ~= cl;
        if (k > 1)
            lowerOnRow ~= lower[k];
        s.horizontal(upper[onRow], cu);
        if (k > 0 && k < 2 * teeth - 1)
            s.horizontal(upper[k], upper[k + 1]);
        if (k == 0)
        {
            firstLower = pl;
            firstUpper = pu;
        }
        if (k == 2 * teeth - 1)
        {
            lastLower = pl;
            lastUpper = pu;
            lastCentre = cu;
        }
    }

    // the end of the slot: parallel to the back, the
    // back's thickness behind it, touching the first
    // pocket of each row where they meet it
    auto end = s.line(lower[0], upper[0]);
    s.parallel(end, left);
    s.distance(lower[0], left, back * cos(lean));
    s.tangent(end, firstLower);
    s.tangent(end, firstUpper);

    // the rows start on the end's line, the gap apart:
    // the upper one level, the lower one tilted by the
    // mouth, down to open it, up to close it
    // (construction lines, which guide the outline
    // without being part of it)
    auto start = s.point(axis * slope, -axis);
    s.on(start, end);
    s.distance(a, start, top - axis, along: Y);
    s.distance(start, upper[1], 2 * axis, along: Y);
    auto lowerRow = s.line(start, lowerOnRow[$ - 1],
        construction: true);
    auto upperRow = s.line(upper[1], lastCentre,
        construction: true);

    // from the lower row to the upper one:
    // counter-clockwise when it opens
    s.angle(lowerRow, upperRow, mouth);
    foreach (p; lowerOnRow[0 .. $ - 1])
        s.on(p, lowerRow);
    s.on(lower[1], lowerRow);

    // the bottom drops with the lower row, from below
    // its start
    auto under = s.point(axis * slope, -top);
    s.vertical(start, under);
    s.horizontal(a, under);
    auto drop = s.line(under, b, construction: true);
    s.parallel(drop, lowerRow);

    // the tips of the jaws, parallel to the back,
    // touching the last teeth
    auto tipLow = s.line(b, lower[$ - 1]);
    auto tipUp = s.line(upper[$ - 1], c);
    s.parallel(tipLow, left);
    s.parallel(tipUp, left);
    s.tangent(tipLow, lastLower);
    s.tangent(tipUp, lastUpper);

    // round outer corners
    foreach (p; [a, b, c])
        s.fillet(p, 2.5.mm);

    return s.profile.extrude(height);
}
```
